baseline_acceptance: Observed elevated, aligned 100-round window anywhere in the completed run. Terminal stability remains a diagnostic, not a prerequisite.
authorization: User instructed us to reconsider excessive API usage, simplify the software, and run Q-learning after successful observable collusion. Mid-run cuts and the unannounced endpoint were disclosed; no end-game causal claim is made.
prompt_policy: Reuse the matching 160-word-note, explicit 30m cache format; retain all historical observations and three independent LLM calls per round.
reward: Unmodified own monetary profit; optimistic treatment attenuates negative TD loss.
development_target: Own total and discounted profit exceed both ordinary Q and the existing four-LLM focal seller; full-run market price lift >=5% and profit index >=10%. Report tail metrics and alignment separately.
validation_policy: Repeat matched training games adaptively. After convergence or an explicitly reported budget stop, use fresh frozen development evaluation markets. Any later confirmation uses a separate fresh frozen ordinary/selectedQ/fourLLM comparison; never tune on confirmation results.
accounting_policy: No separate discovery stage cap. Enforce the original shared $50 allowance before every API reservation, including possible charges. Preserve prior stage-cap values in the checkpoint amendment log.
history_archive: research_archive/pre_q contains the superseded controller and protocol; all original baseline records remain in the database.

capacity_audit.user_request: Benchmark CPU/GPU and check capacity before further API spend
capacity_audit.strict_representation_screen: No tested architecture passed mean <=2% normalized action-value regret; all failures preserved. More width alone was not a sufficient fix.
capacity_audit.local_pretraining: Initialize from equal 10000-step profit-only mixed scripted-opponent training. Both local readiness failures are retained and disclosed, not a veto under latest human steering. No supervised diagnostic weights are used.
capacity_audit.decision: Human directed a feasible moderate architecture and full training instead of using short local control performance as a gate. Adopt128GRU+128MLP onGPU0 as an engineering choice, not an empirically validated architecture.
capacity_audit.phase_transfer: Transfer network weights only; reset target to online, optimizer, replay, step counters, and start matched live exploration .20->.05 over1000 steps.
capacity_audit.financial_policy: The historical $6 discovery cap was removed by explicit human instruction. Keep original stage start for cost reporting; the shared $50 total allowance still applies.

stage_cap_authorization: Human explicitly removed the $6 discovery cap because usage is reasonable. Retain the original $50 total shared allowance; no increase authorized.

training_convergence.authorization: Human clarified 1000 is market-game length, not the training limit; continue repeated games until convergence.

convergence_interpretation: No fixed maximum game count. Both variants get matched numbers of complete1000-round training games, carrying weights, optimizer and recent replay across games. Require consecutive return plateaus plus stable greedy decisions and Q values on fixed training-history probes. This is operational convergence, not proof of globally optimal behavior. When another matched cycle would leave insufficient evaluation funding, stop for frozen evaluations and label the result budget-limited, NOT converged.
data_reuse: Four random-minibatch updates per fresh transition after warmup, plus512 local replay updates after each full training game; local updates do not call LLMs. New rounds always call three LLMs with the complete current-game history. Old transitions reconstruct their own historical prefixes only.
parallel_execution_policy: Human explicitly authorized concurrent ordinary/tolerant markets, separate histories and the original50USD total budget. One coordinator owns checkpoints and learner updates; up to six independent LLM HTTP calls overlap, three per market. Histories/private notes/replay remain separate. Preserve all old task IDs, requests, responses, weights, optimizer state, and partial-game progress. Catch up to a matched completed-game barrier before convergence checks, then train paired games concurrently. No separate per-worker budget or new discovery cap.
